skills.name: modal
skills.description: Build or change a modal, dialog, confirmation, alert or lightbox so it behaves right: native dialog, focus, scroll lock, dismiss, and an enter and exit animation in the app's own style. Use whenever a request makes something into a modal or dialog ("make X a modal", "add a confirmation", "show this in a dialog"), even when it doesn't mention animation. Motion+ recipe.
